name: progress-knight-fr
description: Progress Knight 2.0 en français, version mobile (PWA + application Android via Capacitor)

scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
